generation.scope: A rank-ten, minimally two-periodic standard AS window with a reduced twenty-point scheme realizes two distinct simultaneous Veronese embeddings and is genuinely singly symmetric. Four normal quadratic parameters, a polynomial-module basis lift, quadratic nullhomotopies and depth prove all-degree exactness from a conditional degree-six test.

proof_review.scope: Reviewed the polynomial-basis lift through degree six, normality homotopies, depth induction, period and finite Veronese comparison.

mathematical_computation.scope: Exact rational path dimensions, square-zero quotient, two Koszul rank lists at both starts, normality signs and elimination of maximal minors.

tex.scope: Main 166 pages, plan 6 and notes 13. No overfull boxes, missing characters or unresolved references.

open_mathematics: Vary the three axial coefficients in the marked cross-product example. Determine the full-rank diagonal homogeneous flat solutions, the admissible parameter region and indexed equivalences. Track the normal quadrics and the finite structural test including exceptional fibers.
General singly symmetric and nonsymmetric windows.
